description: Get the KLV or KDA token balance for a Klever blockchain address. Returns the balance in the smallest unit (for KLV: 1 KLV = 1,000,000 units with 6 decimal places). Optionally specify an asset ID to query a specific KDA token balance instead of KLV.

assetId.description: Optional KDA token ID (e.g. "USDT-A1B2", "LPKLVKFI-3I0N"). Omit for KLV balance.

network.description: Network to query. Options: "mainnet", "testnet", "devnet", "local". Defaults to server default (mainnet).

name: get_balance
